recall_prompt: Say how you would find the mean deviation about the median for eleven numbers — what you do to the data first, how you pick the median, and what you average at the end.
insider_note: Keep every repeated value when sorting, so n stays 11 and the median is the 6th value, 13; the two zero deviations still count, and the divisor stays n = 11.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Median
steps.margin_note: First mark. Eleven values, with repeats — keep every copy when sorting. n = 11 is odd, so the median is the ((11 + 1)/2)th = 6th value in order: 13.
steps.memory_tip: Odd n: the median is the ((n + 1)/2)th sorted value, the 6th of 11. Keep every repeat when sorting.
lines: n = 11 is odd, so M = the 6th value.

recall.must_convey: That the eleven values are sorted (keeping repeats), n = 11 is odd, and the median is the 6th value, 13.
accept: put the eleven numbers in order keeping the repeats, eleven is odd so the median is the sixth value, thirteen
sort the data and take the n plus one by two th value, the sixth, which is thirteen
median is the middle value after sorting, thirteen
ascending order lo pettite sixth value thirteen, adi median

steps.why: The median is the middle of the ORDERED data. With repeats, each copy keeps its own position; dropping a repeat changes n and moves the middle.
common_mistakes: Dropping repeated values when sorting, so n becomes 7 and the middle moves.
Counting the middle of the unsorted list.
Taking the mean (154/11 = 14) instead of the median.

steps.label: Mean deviation
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Absolute deviations from 13, written in the GIVEN order as the book does: 0, 4, 3, 2, 0, 3, 3, 2, 5, 1, 4. Sum 27, divide by n = 11. 27/11 = 2.4545…, written 2.45.
steps.memory_tip: The two zero deviations still count: divide 27 by n = 11, not by 9. 27/11 = 2.45.

recall.must_convey: That the absolute deviations from 13 add to 27 and 27/11 gives 2.45.
accept: take each number minus thirteen without sign, add to twenty seven, divide by eleven, two point four five
the absolute deviations from the median add to twenty seven and twenty seven by eleven is two point four five
mean deviation is sigma mod x i minus M by n equals twenty seven by eleven equals two point four five
thirteen nunchi deviations mod teesukoni add cheste twenty seven, eleven tho divide cheste two point four five
the answer is two point four five

steps.why: Mean deviation about the median is the average distance from the median. The two 13's contribute 0 each but still count in n = 11.
common_mistakes: Dividing 27 by 9 after leaving out the two zero terms — the divisor is n = 11.
Subtracting from the mean 14 instead of from the median 13.
